optionReasons.dea-ini-018:option:1: DataBrew is preparing VISUAL Data — not engine SQL Consultation.
optionReasons.dea-ini-018:option:2: The EMR wheel SQL via Spark/Presto, but with CLUSTER provisioned and paid per hour — violates "without infrastructure, paid by consultation".
optionReasons.dea-ini-018:option:3: The RDS is relational bank OLTP — requires uploading data and providing instance.

finalJustifications: Because Athena It's SQL serverless direct on the S3, using the Glue Catalog, collected from scanned data — zero infrastructure.
Because Athena load the Parquet files to an internal columnary bank, where the queries SQL run with optimized indexes.
Because Athena is free for files in column format — the collection by scanned data is only valid for CSV and JSON.
Because Athena only collects when the query returns results, making empty aggregations free of scanning cost.

optionReasons.dea-ini-005:option:0: Snowball is physical transfer of large volumes of files — does not replicate banks continuously.
optionReasons.dea-ini-005:option:1: AppFlow integrates data from SaaS applications (Salesforce etc.) — not on-premises banks.
optionReasons.dea-ini-005:option:3: DataSync Move ARQUIVOS (NFS/SMB) for the AWS — the requirement is replication of BANCO with the origin in operation, which is the CDC of the DMS.

finalJustifications: Because DMS specializes in migrating and replicating banks: full load initial + CDC continuous reading transaction log, with origin in air.
Because DMS pause the Oracle database of origin in short consistency windows, synchronizing snapshots before reactivating it.
Because DMS Automatically convert Oracle server hardware and operating system to instances EC2 Equivalents.
Because DMS transfers the raw data files directly from the server disk, replicating the datafiles in blocks to the AWS.

optionReasons.dea-ini-029:option:0: Deactivate encryption violates the basic requirement of rest protection.
optionReasons.dea-ini-029:option:1: Keeping the key next to the data nullifies the protection — who reads the bucket reads the key.
optionReasons.dea-ini-029:option:3: HTTPS protects IN TRANSIT — the requirement is EM encryption REPOUSO with key-use audit.

finalJustifications: Because SSE-KMS encrypts the objects at rest with a customer managed key, and each key use generates an auditable event in the CloudTrail.
Because SSE-KMS blocks the download of encrypted objects by users without the audit role recorded in CloudTrail.
Because the CMK encrypts the entire pocket at once, applying the cipher to all existing and future objects in a single event.
Because CloudTrail performs the encryption of objects by registering them, unifying the audit and protection in a single service.

optionReasons.dea-ini-014:option:1: Version AUMENTA the cost (guards old versions) — does not move data to colder classes.
optionReasons.dea-ini-014:option:2: Transfer Acceleration UPLOADS long distance — does not reduce storage cost.
optionReasons.dea-ini-014:option:3: Event Notifications trigger actions when objects arrive — do not move data between classes.

finalJustifications: Because lifecycle rules move objects automatically to cheaper classes as they age (IA, Glacier, Deep Archive) and can expire them.
Because lifecycle rules compress old logs into smaller files, reducing cost per gigabyte without changing storage class.
Because the Glacier is free for data with more than 90 days of age — lifecycle only marks objects eligible for exemption.
Because lifecycle rules delete old data and keep only a metadata index, which allows you to restore them on demand.

optionReasons.dea-ini-024:option:0: The CloudTrail audit CHAMADAS of API — shows who started the job, but not the stderr and the trackback of the execution.
optionReasons.dea-ini-024:option:1: The original pocket contains the DADOS of the job — not the execution logs.
optionReasons.dea-ini-024:option:2: Config tracks resource CONFIGURATION changes — no application logs.

finalJustifications: Because Glue send the logs and stderr of each execution to log groups of the CloudWatch Logs — That's where the error traceback is.
Because CloudWatch Logs re-executes the job automatically after failure, attaching the diagnosis of the new attempt to the log group.
Because the logs of Glue are available for only one hour after execution, and the CloudWatch That's where the snapshot gets preserved..
Because CloudWatch Logs records the stdout only of successful jobs — failures are recorded in the events of EventBridge.

optionReasons.dea-ini-008:option:0: The S3 accepted QUALQUER format — no restriction.
optionReasons.dea-ini-008:option:1: Line line describes CSV/Avro — The Parquet is COLUNAR, optimized for analytical reading, not transactional writing.
optionReasons.dea-ini-008:option:3: Opening in Excel is not an analytical architecture criterion.

finalJustifications: Because in column format the engine reads only the columns of SELECT and compresses better by column — less scanned data, less cost.
Because the Parquet encrypts the data automatically by column, exempting the SSE of the S3 in the analytical consultations of the data lake.
Because the Parquet eliminates the need for partitioning: the internal index of the file replaces the partitions by date in S3.
Because the Parquet stores data already aggregated per day, allowing the engine to respond averages and sums without scanning the lines.

optionReasons.dea-ini-010:option:0: The Athena execution SQL serverless — gives no cluster control or spins arbitrary Spark jobs with custom libraries.
optionReasons.dea-ini-010:option:1: Batch calendar generic containers with rows — not a Spark/Hive cluster managed.
optionReasons.dea-ini-010:option:2: The Lambda has a limit of 15 minutes and no support for distributed frameworks.

finalJustifications: Because EMR provides managed clusters of Spark, Hive and the entire Hadoop ecosystem, with fine control of instances, libraries and settings.
Because EMR turns Spark into a serverless service without a visible cluster, abstracting the types of instance and libraries.
Because EMR includes a built-in columnar data warehouse, which stores the results of the Spark and Hive jobs for consultation in SQL standard.
Because EMR is the only supported way to read data from S3 with Spark — the s3a connector is exclusive to the managed clusters of AWS.

optionReasons.dea-ini-003:option:0: The Registration Scheme versions schemas of STREAMING (Open/JSON in Kafka/Kinesis) — do not scan files in S3.
optionReasons.dea-ini-003:option:1: The Glue Studio is the editor VISUAL of jobs ETL — do not discover patterns.
optionReasons.dea-ini-003:option:3: DataBrew is visual data preparation — does not catalog tables.

finalJustifications: 'Cause Crawler's sweeping it S3, infers the file schema and creates/updates tables in Glue Date Catalog — ready for Athena consult.
Because Crawler converts the CSVs and JSONs to Parquet during scanning, recording the optimized version back in S3 already catalogued.
Because Crawler moves the files to a managed relational bank, where the schema is imposed on the load and the tables are consultable.
Because Crawler validates the quality of the data before cataloging, rejecting files whose pattern differs from the table pattern.
